steps.title: Share into fair halves

options.label: Which picture shows two equal parts?
Eight apples are shared fairly by two children. Build one child's share.
These two parts have different sizes. Are they halves?

steps.hint: Compare the two parts in each picture. Halves have the same size.
steps.explanation: Halves must be two equal parts of the same whole.
steps.shortExplanation: Make, count or compare the objects. Explain what changed.

mathWorkshop.title: Share into fair halves
mathWorkshop.goal: Halves must be two equal parts of the same whole.

tasks.prompt: Which picture shows two equal parts?
tasks.feedback: A has two equal parts. B has a larger part and a smaller part, so they are not halves.
tasks.hint: Compare the two parts in each picture. Halves have the same size.

tasks.prompt: Eight apples are shared fairly by two children. Build one child's share.
tasks.feedback: Four apples for each child makes two equal groups: four and four.
tasks.hint: Make two equal groups in your mind. One child must get the same number as the other.

tasks.prompt: These two parts have different sizes. Are they halves?
tasks.feedback: Halves of the same whole must be equal. Two unequal pieces are not halves.
tasks.hint: Check equality, rather than only counting the two pieces.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: Equal parts
steps.prompt: Choose all shapes cut into two equal parts.
steps.hint: Look at each cut. Are both parts the same size?
steps.explanation: Shapes a and c have equal parts. Shape b has unequal parts.
steps.shortExplanation: Shapes a and c have equal parts. Shape b has unequal parts.

source.answerKeyText: a and c. b is cut into two unequal parts.

steps.title: Half of 6
steps.hint: Share 6 into two groups, one at a time.
steps.explanation: Sharing 6 equally between two groups gives 3 each.
steps.shortExplanation: Sharing 6 equally between two groups gives 3 each.

steps.title: Half of 10
steps.hint: Share 10 into two groups, one at a time.
steps.explanation: Sharing 10 equally gives 5 in each group.
steps.shortExplanation: Sharing 10 equally gives 5 in each group.

steps.title: Sharing apples
steps.prompt: Share 8 apples equally between 2 children. How many each?
steps.hint: Give one apple to each child in turn.
steps.explanation: Two equal groups of 4 make 8 apples.
steps.shortExplanation: Two equal groups of 4 make 8 apples.

steps.title: What a half is
steps.prompt: A half is one of how many equal parts?
steps.hint: When we halve, how many equal parts are there?
steps.explanation: A half is one of two equal parts.
steps.shortExplanation: A half is one of two equal parts.

steps.title: The bigger half
steps.prompt: It makes sense to ask for the bigger half.
steps.hint: Can two halves of the same thing be different sizes?
steps.explanation: Halves of the same whole must be the same size.
steps.shortExplanation: Halves of the same whole must be the same size.

source.answerKeyText: False. Halves are always the same size.

steps.title: Try it at home
steps.prompt: With an adult, draw a line cutting a rectangle into two equal parts. Check both parts.
steps.hint: Share equally into two groups. The parts must match.
steps.explanation: Try it with an adult. Talk about what you found.
steps.shortExplanation: Try it with an adult. Talk about what you found.

source.answerKeyText:
A line straight down the middle, straight across the middle, or corner to corner — all
make halves.

parentReview.en:
A line straight down the middle, straight across the middle, or corner to corner — all
make halves.
parentReview.note: Discuss with an adult; this personal or drawing response is not automatically graded.

steps.title: Try it at home
steps.prompt: Name something at home that you can share in half. Explain how both parts can be equal.
steps.hint: Share equally into two groups. The parts must match.
steps.explanation: Try it with an adult. Talk about what you found.
steps.shortExplanation: Try it with an adult. Talk about what you found.

source.answerKeyText: Any sensible answer: a sandwich, an orange, a cake, a pack of biscuits.

parentReview.en: Any sensible answer: a sandwich, an orange, a cake, a pack of biscuits.
parentReview.note: Discuss with an adult; this personal or drawing response is not automatically graded.

steps.title: Fair halves
steps.prompt: Which shape is cut into two halves?
steps.hint: Halves are two parts of the same size.
steps.explanation: Picture c has two equal parts, so they are halves. The others are not.
steps.shortExplanation: Picture c has two equal parts, so they are halves. The others are not.

steps.title: Half of 4
steps.explanation: Two and two make 4, so half of 4 is 2.
steps.shortExplanation: Two and two make 4, so half of 4 is 2.

steps.title: Pizza halves
steps.prompt: A pizza cut into 2 equal parts: each part is...
steps.hint: The pizza has two equal parts. What is one of them called?
steps.explanation: One of two equal parts is one half.
steps.shortExplanation: One of two equal parts is one half.

steps.title: Sharing 6
steps.prompt: Sharing 6 fairly between 2 people gives each...
steps.hint: Give one to each person in turn until none are left.
steps.explanation: Sharing 6 fairly between 2 people gives 3 each.
steps.shortExplanation: Sharing 6 fairly between 2 people gives 3 each.

steps.title: Cut into equal parts
steps.prompt: Which shape is cut into equal parts?
steps.hint: Are all the pieces the same size?
steps.explanation: The square is cut into four equal parts. Equal parts of a whole are a fraction.
steps.shortExplanation: The square is cut into four equal parts. Equal parts of a whole are a fraction.

homeActivities.text: Fold paper so the edges match to make halves. Share 6, 8 or 10 safe large counters equally between two plates and compare both groups.
homeActivities.textAr: اطبقوا ورقة لحد ما الأطراف تيجي على بعض عشان تعملوا نصّين. وقسّموا ٦ أو ٨ أو ١٠ حتت كبيرة وآمنة بالتساوي على طبقين، وقارنوا المجموعتين.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.
